title: Triage a service incident
objective: Recommend an investigation queue from supplied telemetry; do not claim root cause or trigger remediation.

decision.instructions: Read incident `summary` and `observations`. Which investigation queue is best supported, without asserting root cause?

criteria.application: Application errors or regressions are the strongest lead
criteria.infrastructure: Capacity, runtime, or host signals are the strongest lead
criteria.upstream: A dependency outage is the strongest lead

scope: Advisory decision workflow. No native Codex interception or production action.
